name: Job Hunter
summary: Finds new jobs that match you at the companies you care about and runs your whole application pipeline, from applied to offer.
handles: Checks Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards every 6 hours
One digest of new matching roles, never the same job twice
Keeps your pipeline: applied, interview, offer, rejected
Reminds you the day before each interview
Spots applications gone quiet for a week and drafts the follow-up email
setup: Open a company's careers page: boards.greenhouse.io/stripe means "stripe greenhouse", jobs.lever.co/netflix means "netflix lever", jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion means "notion ashby".
Put one company per line under Companies to watch, or tell it "add company figma greenhouse" any time.

fields.label: Companies to watch
fields.default:
stripe greenhouse
netflix lever
notion ashby
fields.help: One per line: the company's board name and where it posts jobs (greenhouse, lever or ashby). Example: stripe greenhouse

fields.label: Title keywords
fields.help: Comma list; a job title must contain one of them. Example: backend, platform, data engineer

fields.label: Skip titles with
fields.help: Comma list of words that rule a job out. Example: intern, staff, manager

fields.label: Locations
fields.help: Comma list; leave empty for anywhere. "remote" matches remote jobs. Example: remote, new york, london

after: Say "companies" to check what it watches, then "jobs" after its first check. When you apply somewhere, tell it "applied 2".
